title.rendered: Bose Quiet Comfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen)

content.rendered:
Bose Quiet Comfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) – Premium In-Ear Adjustable Noise Cancelling Earbuds

Experience next-level audio with the Bose Quiet Comfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen), designed for immersive sound, superior comfort, and advanced adjustable noise cancelling technology. These premium in-ear wireless earbuds deliver crystal-clear audio performance whether you’re commuting, working, or relaxing. Engineered with precision acoustic tuning, built-in microphones, and customizable noise control, they redefine what true wireless earbuds can do.

Featuring adjustable noise cancelling, the Bose Quiet Comfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) allow you to personalize your listening experience. Switch between full noise isolation for flights and busy streets, or reduce noise cancellation to stay aware of your surroundings. The advanced noise control type: adjustable noise cancelling ensures optimal balance between sound clarity and environmental awareness.

Designed with a secure in-ear headphone fit, these earbuds include soft silicone tips that provide long-lasting comfort and a stable fit during workouts, travel, or daily use. The IPX4 water resistant rating protects against sweat and light splashes, making them ideal for gym sessions and outdoor activities.

Communication is effortless with the integrated built-in microphone system. Whether you’re taking business calls or chatting with friends, the advanced mic array ensures clear voice pickup and reduced background noise. With a maximum talk time of 4 hours, you can stay connected without interruption.

Crafted from durable Plastic (PC-ABS), Silicone, and Metal, these combine lightweight construction with premium durability. The compact design makes them easy to carry, while the ergonomic charging case keeps your protected and powered throughout the day.

Key Features

  • Headphone Fit: In Ear
  • Microphones: Built-in Microphone
  • Noise Cancelling: Yes
  • Noise Control Type: Adjustable Noise Cancelling
  • Water Resistant: IPX4 (Sweat & Splash Resistant)
  • Maximum Talk Time: 4 Hours
  • Bud Dimensions: 2.99 x 1.2 x 2.4 cm
  • Bud Weight: 0.016 lb
  • Case Dimensions: 6.6 x 5.9 x 2.69 cm
  • Case Weight: 0.132 lb
  • Product Material: Plastic (PC-ABS), Silicone, Metal
  • Rechargeable: Yes

Premium Sound with Smart Noise Control

The are engineered for rich bass, balanced mids, and detailed highs. Whether you stream music, watch movies, or attend virtual meetings, these Bluetooth noise cancelling deliver studio-quality performance. The customizable adjustable noise cancelling feature allows users to fine-tune their environment, offering a seamless transition between immersive listening and awareness mode.

Comfortable & Travel-Friendly Design

With compact bud dimensions of 2.99 x 1.2 x 2.4 cm and a lightweight 0.016 lb design, these wireless in-ear are built for portability. The charging case (6.6 x 5.9 x 2.69 cm) fits easily into pockets or bags, making them perfect travel companions. The rechargeable battery ensures reliable everyday performance.

Why Choose?

If you’re searching for best noise cancelling with adjustable sound control, premium materials, and water resistance, the stand out. Their in-ear ergonomic fit, built-in microphones, IPX4 rating, and reliable rechargeable design make them suitable for professionals, fitness enthusiasts, and everyday users alike. Upgrade your audio experience with the perfect combination of comfort, durability, and advanced adjustable noise cancelling technology in a sleek, compact design.
